name: artis-ui-framework

scripts.build:libs: ng build theme && ng build toaster && ng build api && ng build ui
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:demo
scripts.test: npm run lint:tokens && ng test theme --no-watch && ng test toaster --no-watch && ng test api --no-watch && ng test ui --no-watch
scripts.test:coverage: ng test theme --no-watch --coverage && ng test toaster --no-watch --coverage && ng test api --no-watch --coverage && ng test ui --no-watch --coverage

description: Framework Angular interne Artis : @artis/theme, @artis/toaster, @artis/api, @artis/ui + application de démonstration.
